The company is engaged in sugar and [[Alcoholic drink|alcohol]], including [[ethanol]] production, [[Power Generation|power co-generation]], [[power transmission]], including industrial gears & gearboxes and defence, [[water treatment]] solutions and [[FMCG]] brands.{{cite book |last1=C. S. With more factories on the anvil, Triveni is well ...}} == History == [[File:Dhruv Sawhney, Chairman, Triveni Engineering & Industries, at the Horasis Global India Business Meeting 2009 - Flickr - Horasis.jpg|200px|thumb|right| Dhruv Sawhney, Chairman and Managing Director of Triveni Engineering & Industries at the [[Horasis|Horasis Global India Business Meeting]] 2009]] Dhruv Sawhney, Chairman and Managing Director of Triveni Engineering & Industries at the [[Horasis|Horasis Global India Business Meeting]] 2009. The company was founded on 27 July 1932, and incorporated under the provisions of [[Companies Act 2013|Companies Act 1956]], as The Ganga Sugar Corporation Limited. It received a certificate of commencement of business on 6 February 1933.{{cite news |title=Board of Triveni Engineering and Industries Gives Approval for Two New Distilleries in UP |url=https://www.news18.com/news/business/board-of-triveni-engineering-and-industries-gives-approval-for-two-new-distilleries-in-up-3388934.html |publisher=[[News 18]] |date=4 February 2021}} It acquired the Khatauli sugar plant in 1952. In 1973, it was renamed Gangeshwar Limited from The Ganga Sugar Corporation. It was renamed Triveni Engineering & Industries Limited in 2000.{{cite book |title=Industry, Financial Aggregates & Ratios |date=2002 |publisher=[[Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy]] |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=FnrtAAAAMAAJ&q=Gangeshwar+Ltd+change |quote=Triveni Engg . Works merged with Triveni Engg & Inds . which was later amalgamated with Gangeshwar Ltd. w.e.f. 31.3.2000 and the name of Gangeshwar Ltd. was changed to Triveni Engg . & Inds . Ltd. Co - operative sugar mills}} In 2005, it started a rural retail chain, Khushali Bazaar, under its fully owned retail arm, Triveni Retail Ventures Ltd, which operated in [[Uttar Pradesh]] and [[Uttarakhand]]. Later, it was shut down in 2013.{{cite news |last1=Modi |first1=Ajay |title=Triveni shuts down rural retail biz |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/triveni-shuts-down-rural-retail-biz-110041600012_1.html |publisher=[[Business Standard]] |date=21 January 2013}}{{cite news |title=Triveni Khushali plans 200 outlets by 2009 |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/newxhlSRtNN4U2flppypiJ/Triveni-Khushali-plans-200-outlets-by-2009.html |publisher=[[Livemint]] |date=17 July 2007}}{{cite news |last1=Vijayraghavan |first1=Kala |title=Triveni to sell off its rural superstore chain |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/retail/triveni-to-sell-off-its-rural-superstore-chain/articleshow/3666204.cms?from=mdr |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=3 November 2008}} In 2007, the company entered the [[Alcohol (drug)|alcohol]] business by setting up its first distillery in [[Muzaffarpur]], which has a capacity to produce 160 kilo per day. In 2019, the company set up another distillery at Sabitgarh unit with a capacity of 160KLPD.{{citation needed|date=January 2023}} On 13 June 2018, a concession agreement was signed between [[National Mission for clean Ganga|National Mission for Clean Ganga]] (NMCG), Uttar Pradesh Jal Nigam, and Triveni Engineering to develop India's first city-wide integrated sewage infrastructure for [[Mathura]] at an estimated cost of over ₹437 crore on a Hybrid Annuity-based mode.{{cite news |last=Purthi |first=Rupali |date=16 June 2018 |title=NMCG, UP Jal Nigam and Triveni Engineering sign agreement for development of sewage infrastructure |url=https://www.jagranjosh.com/current-affairs/nmcg-up-jal-nigam-and-triveni-engineering-sign-agreement-for-development-of-sewage-infrastructure-1528896992-1 |access-date=2024-02-22 |work=Jagran Josh, [[Dainik Jagaran]] |publisher=}} In 2020, the company forayed into the [[Desi daru|country liquor]] space by launching four liquor brands, including Miss Rangeeli and Shahenshah.{{cite news |last1=Chaliawala |first1=Nehal |title=Sugar barons push into the country liquor business, strike gold |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/liquor/sugar-barons-push-into-the-country-liquor-business-strike-gold/articleshow/86699178.cms |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=2 October 2021}} In March 2021, it was assigned to build a desalination plant in the [[Maldives]].{{cite news |last1=Chaudhury |first1=Dipanjan Roy |title=India signs contract to develop water projects across Maldives |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/politics-and-nation/india-signs-contract-to-develop-water-projects-across-maldives/articleshow/81553460.cms?from=mdr |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=17 March 2021}} In November 2021, Engineering Power Transmission business signed a 10-year contract with US-based GEAE Technology to manufacture the '[[General Electric LM2500|LM2500]]' gas turbine base and enclosure, which powers many of the [[Indian Navy]]'s vessels.{{cite news |title=Triveni Engineering inks pact with GEAE Tech to manufacture gas turbine base |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/engineering/triveni-engineering-inks-pact-with-geae-tech-to-manufacture-gas-turbine-base/articleshow/87847531.cms?from=mdr |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=22 November 2021}} The company, on 6 February 2025, signed a [[Memorandum of Understanding]] (MoU) with [[Rolls-Royce North America|Rolls-Royce Marine North America Inc.]] for collaboration on the programmes for the AG 9160 {{Convert|4|MW|abbr=on}} marine [[gas turbine]] generators (GTG) in India.{{Cite news |last= |first= |date=2025-02-06 |title=Triveni Engineering and Industries and Rolls-Royce signs MoU |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/triveni-engineering-and-industries-and-rolls-royce-signs-mou-125020600415_1.html |access-date=2025-03-14 |work=Business Standard |language=en-IN}}{{Cite news |last= |first= |date=2023-01-28 |title=GRSE signs MoU to manufacture Rolls Royce marine engines in India |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/grse-signs-mou-to-manufacture-rolls-royce-marine-engines-in-india/article66443766.ece |access-date=2025-03-14 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}} Recently, the company announced [[Indian-made foreign liquor]] ([[IMFL]]) business has started commercial operations on 16 July 2024.{{Cite web |last=Standard |first=Business |title=Triveni Engg commences production of two new whiskies |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/triveni-engg-commences-production-of-two-new-whiskies-124071800101_1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241206172655/https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/triveni-engg-commences-production-of-two-new-whiskies-124071800101_1.html |archive-date=2024-12-06 |access-date=2025-06-20 |website=www.business-standard.com |language=en-US}} In March 2024, Triveni Engineering & Industries Ltd, acquired a 25.43 per cent stake in Sir Shadi Lal Enterprises Ltd (SSEL) for Rs 35 crore.  Later in June 2024, the company announced the acquisition of an additional 36.34% stake in sugar firm Sir Shadi Lal Enterprises Ltd for Rs 45 crore, bringing its total stake to 61.77%. This acquisition is expected to enhance operational efficiencies and align with Triveni's strategic objectives.{{Cite web |title=Triveni Engineering Expands Its Stake in Sir Shadi Lal Enterprises {{!}} Business |url=https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/business/2990577-triveni-engineering-expands-its-stake-in-sir-shadi-lal-enterprises |access-date=2025-06-20 |website=Devdiscourse |language=en}} In December 2024, Triveni Engineering & Industries Ltd. (TEIL) announced the approval of a Composite Scheme of Arrangement, involving its the [[demerger]] of its PTB Undertaking to Triveni Power Transmission, pending regulatory approvals.{{Cite web |date=5 February 2025 |title=Triveni Engg Q3 PAT slides 69% YoY to Rs 46 crore {{!}} Capital Market News - Business Standard |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/triveni-engg-q3-pat-slides-69-yoy-to-rs-46-crore-125020500970_1.html |access-date=2025-06-20}} == Operations == The company operates eight sugar mills at [[Khatauli]], [[Deoband]], Sabitgarh, [[Chandanpur]], Rani Nangal, [[Milak]] Narayanpur, [[Ramkola]] and Shamli in Uttar Pradesh. The company also has six co-generation power plants across five sugar units.{{cite news |last1=Kapoor |first1=Rajiv |title=Triveni Engineering is a good buy |url=https://www.sundayguardianlive.com/opinion/10708-triveni-engineering-good-buy |publisher=[[The Sunday Guardian]] |date=2 September 2017}} Currently, the total distillation capacity of the company stands at 860 KLPD.{{Cite web |last=Mishra |first=Prabhudatta |date=2024-01-31 |title=Triveni Engg upbeat on sugar sector, but cautious on ethanol |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/economy/agri-business/triveni-engg-upbeat-on-sugar-sector-but-cautious-on-ethanol/article67797099.ece |access-date=2025-06-20 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}} TEIL has co-generation plants with a total capacity to generate power of 105 MW. It has gear manufacturing facility in [[Mysore]]. It is engaged in manufacturing high-speed gears and gearboxes of up to 70MW capacity with speeds of 70,000 RPM.{{cite news |title=Triveni Engineering sees recovery trend in gear business |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/triveni-engineering-sees-recovery-trend-in-gear-business/article32344911.ece |publisher=[[The Hindu Business Line]] |date=13 August 2020}} The company also sells [[refined sugar]] (40 per cent) and produces pharma grade sugar, which it sells mainly through institutional buyers, like soft drinks, candy and ice-cream makers. TEIL is also into [[water treatment]] solutions and has undertaken various [[sewage treatment]] projects. The company has got 120 plants working over the last few decades. In the [[Engineering, procurement, and construction|EPC]] division, Triveni had undertaken hydel projects, [[waste treatment]] and water projects and coal beneficiation and minerals concession projects.{{cite news |last1=Parikh |first1=Daksesh |title=Triveni Engineering soars high |url=https://businessindia.co/magazine/triveni-engineering-soars-high |publisher=[[Business India]] |date=18 May 2021}} The company is engaged in manufacturing defence products mainly related to the [[Indian Navy]]. Their defence supplies include [[propulsion systems]], [[steam turbine]]s and [[Turbosteamer|turbo steam]] engines. == Financials == In FY25, the company reported a revenue of 5,746.88 crore (March 2025) with a profit 324.14 crore.{{Cite news |last=Moneycontrol.com |title=Triveni Engineering and Industries Profit & Loss account, Triveni Engineering and Industries Financial Statement & Accounts |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/financials/triveniengineeringindustries/profit-lossVI/te10 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250605054101/https://www.moneycontrol.com/financials/triveniengineeringindustries/profit-lossVI/te10 |archive-date=2025-06-05 |access-date=2025-06-20 |language=en}} == Awards and recognition == * The company was ranked at 5 in the list of 'Top 10 Sugar Companies by Highest Sales in India', by Indiastat India Top 10 Yearbook 2016.{{cite book |title=Indiastat India Top 10 Yearbook 2016 |date=2016 |publisher=Publication Cell, Datanet India Pvt. Limited |isbn=9789380590608 |page=79 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=csMyDwAAQBAJ&dq=Triveni+Engineering&pg=PA79}} * It was awarded the [[Frost & Sullivan]] Growth Excellence Award in the water and wastewater treatment industry category by [[Frost & Sullivan]] in 2010.{{cite web |title=Triveni Engineering Awarded |url=https://www.cleanindiajournal.com/triveni_engineering_awarded/ |publisher=Clean India Journal |date=1 March 2011}} * The company won the Greentech Platinum Safety Award and Greentech Silver Safety Award.{{cite web |title=Seeds of Success |url=https://www.bseindia.com/bseplus/AnnualReport/532356/5323560318.pdf |website=[[bseindia.com]]}} * The Khatauli co-generation plant won the Gold award in EKDKN Innov Award 2017 under the [[Occupational safety and health|OHS]] category in power. * In 2017, the distillery unit won the Golden Peacock Business Excellence Award in the chemical sector from the [[Institute of Directors (India)]]. == See also == {{Portal|Companies}} * [[Sugar industry of India]] == References == {{reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Triveni Engineering and Industries Limited}} [[Category:Sugar companies of India]] [[Category:Conglomerate companies of India]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1932]] [[Category:Engineering companies of India]] [[Category:Energy companies of India]] [[Category:Alcohol fuel producers]] [[Category:Electric-generation companies of India]] [[Category:Drink companies of India]] [[Category:Agriculture companies established in the 1930s]] [[Category:Companies established in 1932]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Noida]] [[Category:Food and drink companies established in 1932]] [[Category:1932 establishments in India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
extract: Triveni Engineering & Industries Limited (TEIL) is an Indian conglomerate with diversified businesses in sugar and engineering, headquartered in Noida, India. It was founded in 1932. The company is engaged in sugar and alcohol, including ethanol production, power co-generation, power transmission, including industrial gears & gearboxes and defence, water treatment solutions and FMCG brands. It is the second-largest sugar producer in India.
